supplemental_items.interpretation: Loop is unconditional; transition.index must satisfy strictly 0<boundary<len(current.candles), independent of visible start. Otherwise raise RuntimeError. Closure captures current context, boundary and direction via default arguments. Slice [0,boundary), excluding transition candle. has_history tests visible start<=end; if false replace visible bounds by full prefix [0,len-1] for internal proof while preserving false flag. Calculate prefix without continuation, resolve highs only for exact bearish, otherwise lows, through full prefix final index, not visible end. Return offset, first candle timestamp, original history flag, payload, confirmed points. Finally call release_indexes when non-null, else live fallback only when live non-null; prefix construction and replacement are before try. Non-null live delegates to closed_regime with closure instead of directly invoking it.
